description: Tennessee Secretary of State business entity database download (paid). Gated on purchase. See docs/registry/sources/tn-sos-entities.md.

sources.publisher: Tennessee Secretary of State, Division of Business Services (Business Services Online)
sources.gate: Purchase. The Secretary of State sells the full business entity database through the Business Services Online shopping cart (tnbear.tn.gov, 'Database Download'): $50.00 plus any service fee for a .zip of four tab-separated files regenerated each Sunday night (entity information with mailing address, assumed names, registered agents, annual report history), per the page's description in a search listing. The collector cannot read the page (tnbear.tn.gov resets the connection; sos.tn.gov answers 403 to robots.txt). Requires a person: buy the download, read the terms shown at checkout, and place the zip in collected/tn-sos-entities/.
sources.license: Not read (the page is unreachable from the collector). Business filings are public records under the Tennessee Public Records Act (T.C.A. 10-7-503); the sale terms are shown at checkout
sources.notes: Do not store the natural-person names in registered agent and officer fields. The layout of the four files is not published on a page the collector could reach; an adapter waits for the bought file.
